letters.subject: Submission of Advance Payment Guarantee and Performance Security for Approval of Form
body_paragraphs: We refer to our letter HEL001-L-CO-HEP-QSE-0001 confirming the executed contract documents and the pre-commencement contractual deliverables.

In accordance with the Particular Conditions, we attach for your prior approval of form (1) the draft Advance Payment Guarantee in the amount of USD 9,500,000, being 10% of the Contract Price of USD 95,000,000, and (2) the draft Performance Security. Both drafts are in the wording proposed by our bank. The Advance Payment Guarantee is to remain valid until the advance payment has been fully repaid through the deductions provided in the contract, and the Performance Security is to remain valid for the period required by the Particular Conditions. The amount and validity of the Performance Security follow the Particular Conditions, and we ask you to confirm that the draft reflects your understanding.

We ask that QSE (i) confirm that the wording is acceptable or provide its comments within 5 days of the date of this letter, that is by 7 December 2026, and (ii) confirm whether the proposed issuing bank is acceptable to QSE, and advise of any requirement as to the bank's rating, domicile or confirmation by a local bank. We will send the identity of the issuing bank under separate cover once the bank has confirmed its credit line.

The original Advance Payment Guarantee must be in QSE's hands before the advance payment falls due on 5 January 2027 (Milestone M03). To keep this date we need your approval of form in good time for the bank to issue the originals ahead of the Notice to Proceed on 15 December 2026.

We would be pleased to discuss the drafts at the Kick-off Meeting on 3 December 2026, and have also prepared the NTP precondition checklist for presentation under the agenda. Please note that this letter is sent without prejudice to the rights of HEP under the Contract.

emails.subject: RE: Review period and notice obligations for Procedure section 6
emails.body:
Nilufar,

I am checking the review periods and notice and transmittal obligations in the EPC Contract and its Particular Conditions and will send you a clause-referenced note by 3 December. Until then please keep the section 6 review period marked as provisional. Please also note that contractual notices must be issued as formal letters and not by email, and must be logged on the day of issue.

Thomas
